title.en: Tune up the multilingual learning hub

purpose.en: Make speaking, vocabulary, play, courses, and AI easier to discover while sharing one persistent repeat-after-me preference across learning activities.
purpose.zh: 让生活口语、词汇、游戏、课程和 AI 更容易选择，并在学习活动之间共享一个持久的跟读开关。

en: Default Repeat after me to on in Everyday Speaking and vocabulary practice, with one browser-global preference that persists across scenarios.
Add vocabulary speech scoring, twenty-word library pages, and click-any-word practice starting points.
Replace the primary menu with Everyday speaking, Learn through play, Choose course, and Ask AI.
Add four homepage sliders that select an activity first and one of twelve target languages second.
Group signed-in learning areas by joined target-language tabs on the Dashboard.
zh: 生活口语和词汇练习默认开启跟读，并使用一个可跨场景保留的浏览器全局开关。
词汇练习加入发音评分、每页二十词和点击任意词开始学习。
主菜单调整为生活口语、边玩边学、选择课程和咨询AI。
首页新增四个滑动选择区，先选内容，再从十二种目标语言中选择。
登录后的用户面板按已加入的目标语言标签组织学习区域。

en: Homepage
Shared header
Everyday Speaking
Vocabulary memory workspace and API
AI assistant targeting
Member Dashboard
Project release history
zh: 首页
共享页头
生活口语
词汇记忆工作区与接口
AI 目标语言
会员用户面板
项目发布历史

en: Store only the repeat preference in localStorage; speech transcripts and scores remain transient.
Allow vocabulary API daily decks to begin at an explicitly selected catalog word while preserving due-review behavior otherwise.
Pass selected target language and practice mode into Ask AI prompts and browser speech recognition.
Show only languages represented by active joined courses on signed-in Dashboard tabs.
zh: 本地仅保存跟读开关；语音文本和评分仍为临时状态。
词汇接口可从用户明确选择的目录词开始每日练习，其余情况仍保留到期复习逻辑。
将所选目标语言和练习模式传入咨询AI提示及浏览器语音识别。
登录后的用户面板只显示活跃已加入课程所对应的语言标签。

en: Automated contracts cover global Repeat after me behavior, twenty-word pagination, click-to-start vocabulary, four navigation entries, homepage sliders, Dashboard tabs, and AI language targeting.
Production build, sensitive-data scan, artifact validation, and the full repository regression suite pass.
Chrome production checks cover the anonymous selection flow, speaking preference persistence, responsive layouts, and signed-in learning surfaces where an existing session is available.
zh: 自动契约覆盖全局跟读、每页二十词、点击词汇开始、四项菜单、首页滑块、用户面板语言标签和 AI 目标语言。
生产构建、敏感数据扫描、产物校验和仓库全量回归通过。
Chrome 生产验收覆盖匿名选择流程、跟读偏好保留、响应式布局，以及存在登录会话时的会员学习界面。

en: Automatic pronunciation scoring depends on browser SpeechRecognition support and microphone permission; listening and manual practice remain available otherwise.
zh: 自动发音评分取决于浏览器 SpeechRecognition 支持和麦克风权限；其他情况下仍可听读与人工练习。

en: This release changes only SmartLingo learning flows; no other portfolio site requires the domain-specific vocabulary or speaking behavior.
zh: 本次发布仅调整 SmartLingo 学习流程；其他站点不需要同步其专属词汇或口语逻辑。
